description: A production planning manager must authorize and document an additive-manufacturing run of replacement impellers for a customer, choosing the printer, material reservation, inspection plan, and powder-safety controls with input from quality, maintenance, materials, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: The plant must produce 18 replacement impellers in the additive-manufacturing bay for an approved customer order.
shared_context.S2: Printer P1 and Printer P2 are installed in the bay, and both can produce the impeller geometry.
shared_context.S3: Printer P1 is normally used for this product, while Printer P2 is available for the production window.
shared_context.S4: The daily production-readiness huddle records the final run plan after production planning checks with quality, maintenance, materials, and environmental health and safety.

PF1.text: Jonas reviewed drawing revision C in the quality document system and found that release requires a computed-tomography scan of all 18 impellers plus tensile testing of exactly 4 witness coupons; the revision notice is still awaiting his quality-system acknowledgment.

PF2.text: Priya's maintenance inspection found that Printer P1's recoater calibration is overdue and P1 must not be used for this run; Printer P2 is ready, but changing its build plate requires exactly 90 minutes before the build can start, and she has not closed the inspection ticket.

PF3.text: Leon verified the material certificate for powder lot MP-77 and calculated that exactly 23 kg must be reserved for the 18 impellers, the 4 witness coupons, and the required process allowance; the certificate remains in the receiving folder pending materials-system entry.

PF4.text: Fatima's review of the updated powder safety data sheet classifies this lot as combustible dust requiring an inert-gas purge and documented bonding verification before the build; she is waiting for EHS signoff to post the revised bay instruction.

acceptance_conditions: Printer P2 must be selected because Printer P1 is not qualified for this run.
The build-plate changeover must be scheduled for exactly 90 minutes.
Exactly 18 impellers must be included in the run.
Powder lot MP-77 must be selected with exactly 23 kg reserved.
All 18 impellers must receive computed-tomography scanning.
Exactly 4 witness coupons must be scheduled for tensile testing.
The plan must require both an inert-gas purge and documented bonding verification before the build.
The quality revision finding must be cited as a justification.

decisive_facts.why: Drawing revision C changes the inspection plan from routine sampling to CT scanning all 18 impellers and tensile testing exactly 4 witness coupons, while also supplying the fact required for citation.
The maintenance inspection changes the machine choice from the usual P1 to P2 and changes the setup duration from an unspecified changeover to exactly 90 minutes.
The material calculation changes the reservation to powder lot MP-77 with exactly 23 kg allocated for the run.
The updated safety classification changes the decision fields from no special powder controls to requiring both an inert-gas purge and documented bonding verification.
